mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the sensory and motor routes was most worthwhile: the planned illustrations trace both directions of signalling and show where the cell bodies remain.

leastWorthwhile.text: Building four central regions by repeatedly adding neural tissue became predictable, although the functional insets gave the results useful context.

surprise.text: The spinal sensory input branches into a local circuit and an ascending route, making its two destinations clearer than a simple line to the brain would.

arbitrary.text: Connecting the cerebellum directly to the brainstem seemed anatomically supported, but the game required the cerebrum connection first. Compatibility feedback completed that step automatically.

continue.text: I would continue: tracing the peripheral routes toward their eventual tissue connections is interesting, and the final model leaves those connections visibly open.
